adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` the new `createAllCalendarEvents` logic iterates `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and may perform `prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` and then `await createEvent(...)` per destination. There is no per-iteration try/catch, and both the Prisma call and `createEvent`’s internal `await getCalendar(credential)` can throw (they are not caught inside `createEvent` except for `calendar.createEvent`). Therefore a failure for one destination can abort the whole loop, potentially after some earlier destinations already created external calendar events, preventing the function from returning the partial `createdEvents` list to whatever code persists references, which can leave already-created events untracked/orphaned.
